name: pagination-state
title: Pagination state
description: Pages kept in component state, with buttons.

files.content:
import { Component, computed, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { NdIcon } from '@ndop/core'; import { Pagination, PaginationContent, PaginationItem, PaginationLink, PaginationNext, PaginationPrevious, } from '@/ui/pagination/pagination'; /** * Pages kept in component state: buttons instead of links, with the * current page marked and the arrows disabled at either end. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-pagination-state', imports: [ NdIcon, Pagination, PaginationContent, PaginationItem, PaginationLink, PaginationNext, PaginationPrevious, ], template: `

Showing results {{ (page() - 1) * 10 + 1 }} to {{ page() * 10 }} of 50

    • @for (number of pages(); track number) {
    • }
`, }) export class PaginationStateExample { protected readonly count = 5; protected readonly page = signal(1); protected readonly pages = computed(() => Array.from({ length: this.count }, (_, index) => index + 1), ); }
